description: 引离白后——解法1：象牺牲引后，黑后杀入f2
explanation_en: Black's bishop sacrifice deflects the white queen from e2. Once the queen leaves its defensive post, Black's queen can deliver mate on f2.

intro.popup: 💡 引离：黑方如何牺牲象，把白后引离e2，让黑后杀入f2绝杀？
intro.popup_en: 💡 Deflection: How can Black sacrifice a bishop to draw White's queen away from e2 and allow a mating attack on f2?

outro.popup: ✅ 要点：Ba6！白方若Qxb5（被引离），白后离开e2保护，黑后Qxf2绝杀。引离的精华：让保护者离开关键防线。
outro.popup_en: ✅ Key idea: Ba6! If White captures with Qxb5, the queen leaves its post on e2 and no longer guards f2, allowing Qxf2#.

moves.popup: 黑象Ba6！冷静的弃子——吸引白兵b5来吃，进而引离白后。
moves.popup_en: Black plays Ba6!, offering the bishop to draw the b-pawn forward and then deflect White's queen.
White advances b5 to attack the bishop and takes the bait.

moves.popup: 黑象Bxb5，吃掉白兵，白后必须吃回。
moves.popup_en: Black's bishop captures the pawn on b5, forcing White's queen to recapture.

moves.popup: 白后被引离e2！后去了b5，f2的防守空虚了！
moves.popup_en: White's queen is drawn away from e2 to b5, leaving f2 undefended.

moves.popup: 黑后Qxf2# 绝杀！白后已被引离，f2无人守卫，绝杀！
moves.popup_en: Qxf2# is checkmate! White's queen has been deflected, leaving f2 unprotected.
